stories.title: North Korea fires two ballistic missiles hours apart ahead of Trump-Xi summit
stories.summary: North Korea launched two short-range ballistic missiles from its Wonsan area toward the East Sea on Sunday, about three hours apart, with one flying roughly 450 km and the other more than 600 km. The tests, days before the Trump-Xi summit in Washington, are seen as Pyongyang signaling it won't back down on its weapons buildup.

stories.title: Iran war: Tehran warns of 'painful' response if US launches new attack
stories.summary: In its live coverage, Al Jazeera reports Tehran is calling for an end to the war and the lifting of the US naval blockade while warning of a 'painful' response to any new American strike. The warning comes as the US-Iran conflict widens and Iran-backed Houthi attacks draw Saudi Arabia deeper into the regional war.

stories.title: TypeSafe AI's 'Jev' decision model puts frontier AI price premium under pressure
stories.summary: TypeSafe AI, co-founded by ex-OpenAI researcher Diogo Almeida, launched Jev, a model that returns structured decisions instead of chat text and claims to be hundreds of times cheaper and faster than frontier models. The debut adds pricing pressure on OpenAI and Anthropic ahead of their expected public listings.

stories.title: Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI and Google face antitrust lawsuit over AI slowdown 'agreement'
stories.summary: Four AI subscribers filed a proposed class-action in California accusing Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI and Google of violating antitrust law by agreeing to slow AI development. The suit points to Dario Amodei's cooperation proposal and the embedded-evaluator push as a 'self-serving' arrangement that lowers the value of paid AI subscriptions.

stories.title: Anthropic reportedly weighing a new model as OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra gains momentum
stories.summary: Reuters reports Anthropic is considering releasing a new model to counter the traction of OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra, a move that would undercut CEO Dario Amodei's recent call to slow AI development. Any release is reportedly being weighed ahead of a potential Anthropic IPO.

stories.title: Browns expected to re-evaluate Deshaun Watson, with Shedeur Sanders in line for a shot
stories.summary: ESPN and NFL Network report the Browns will re-examine their quarterback situation after Week 2 against Tampa Bay, with Shedeur Sanders positioned to get a chance if Deshaun Watson struggles. The game pairs Watson against Baker Mayfield, the ex-Browns QB who was traded away when Cleveland signed Watson.

stories.title: Ohio State slips a spot in new AP Top 25 despite 59-3 victory
stories.summary: Even after a 59-3 win over Kent State, Ohio State dropped one spot in the new AP Top 25 poll, partly because Ole Miss beat LSU. Buckeyes coverage highlights a dominant defensive performance wrapping up the non-conference slate heading into Big Ten play.

stories.title: Ohio State drops to No. 7 in coaches poll despite 59-3 win over Kent State
stories.summary: Ohio State fell to No. 7 in the latest US LBM Coaches Poll even after routing Kent State 59-3, slipping for a second straight week following its earlier loss at Texas. The Buckeyes now turn to the start of Big Ten play.

stories.title: Woman killed in multi-vehicle crash on I-670 westbound in Columbus
stories.summary: A 22-year-old Columbus woman, Jordan Decker, died early Sunday in a multi-vehicle crash on westbound I-670 near the State Route 315 ramp, and police say another vehicle involved may have fled the scene. Authorities are investigating the wreck.

stories.title: Evacuations lifted in Pickaway County after overnight flooding
stories.summary: Pickaway County emergency officials lifted evacuations after heavy overnight rain caused major flooding early Sunday, with residents in the Laurelville area allowed to return once roadways reopened. Multiple central Ohio counties saw water rescues during the storms.
